$comment: The public site, as an allowlist. scripts/build-public.mjs copies exactly these files into public/ and vercel.json deploys that directory, so a new file is private until it is added here. Not served itself. Patterns: * matches within one path segment. A group marked dynamic lists assets that are only referenced from JavaScript or runtime code; check-public fails if one of them is no longer referenced anywhere. See research/openspec/changes/public-allowlist-output/.

Never listed here: the four build inputs partials/feedback.html, partials/footer.html, partials/nav.html and learnings/_article-template.html, which are never served.
